sourceMeaning.singleStar: The listed XP figure applies to destruction of the material-plane form; permanently killing the creature multiplies the listed XP by ten.

sourceMeaning.scopeLimit: This review validates the ten marked row identities and the qualifier meanings, not the complete Appendix E table-cell values or all monster profiles.

sourcePixelReview.adjudication: The root report's ten-row and ×10 permanent-kill claim is corroborated on source pixels. The double-star variable-XP distinction is also corroborated. No correction to this bounded source assertion is needed.

rootReportHashReconciliation.finding: The input report labels these as searchDocumentSha256 and hashes the full publicSearch object using canonical JSON; the independently recomputed hashes match exactly. SHA256 of the searchText field alone is a separate projection and differs.
rootReportHashReconciliation.disposition: No hash discrepancy remains. Bind the root report searchDocumentSha256 values as canonical hashes of the full publicSearch object; bind searchText-only hashes separately with their narrower definition. This resolution does not change the pixel-confirmed DMG footnote.

resolution.result: Both root-reported searchDocument hashes exactly match the pinned snapshot’s canonical full publicSearch objects. The searchText-only hashes are a different, also valid, projection. This is a serialization distinction, not a factual hash defect.
